items.source: This implementation sets the default headers by calling addDefaultHeaders(HttpHeaders, T, MediaType), and then calls writeInternal(T, HttpOutputMessage).

items.source: This base class adds support for setting supported MediaTypes, through the supportedMediaTypes bean property. It also adds support for Content-Type and Content-Length when writing to output messages.
items.translation: 这个基类通过 `supportedMediaTypes` 属性支持设置支持的 `MediaTypes`。它还增加了在写入输出消息时支持 `Content-Type` 和 `Content-Length`。

items.source: This implementation delegates to getDefaultContentType(Object) if a content type was not provided, set if necessary the default character set, calls getContentLength(T, MediaType), and sets the corresponding headers.
items.translation: 此实现如果未提供内容类型，则委托给 getDefaultContentType(Object)；如有必要，设置默认字符集；调用 getContentLength(T, MediaType)；并设置相应的标头。

items.source: By default, this returns the first element of the supportedMediaTypes property, if any. Can be overridden in subclasses.
items.translation: 默认情况下，如果存在该属性，则返回`supportedMediaTypes`属性的第一个元素。可在子类中重写此方法。

items.source: Return the list of media types supported by this converter. The list may not apply to every possible target element type and calls to this method should typically be guarded via canWrite(clazz, null. The list may also exclude MIME types supported only for a specific class. Alternatively, use HttpMessageConverter.getSupportedMediaTypes(Class) for a more precise list.
items.translation: 返回此转换器支持的媒体类型列表。该列表可能不适用于所有可能的目标元素类型，因此调用此方法时通常应通过 canWrite(clazz, null 进行保护。该列表也可能仅排除特定类支持的 MIME 类型。或者，使用 HttpMessageConverter.getSupportedMediaTypes(Class) 获取更精确的列表。
